text: APPROVE. Moving the null/empty/equal-to-`dir` parent check into `ParentOrNull` keeps the same condition and the same `break`, and removes one `||` from `IsTemplateProject`, which takes its cognitive complexity from 16 to 15. The new helper is a small private static method with nullable annotations that flow cleanly, so I see no reason for a build break. I judged this from the diff alone, since the full file isn't available here, so I haven't confirmed it builds with warnings as errors.
